name: Microsoft 365 audit alerts
summary: 29 security alerts for Microsoft 365 Management API audit logs
description:
Event definitions for Office 365 / Entra audit logs collected into Graylog. Every query and threshold was validated against 90 days of real tenant data before inclusion - see the README for the failure modes this set exists to avoid.

After importing: set the notification recipients, point the definitions at your own stream(s), and edit the per-user country exceptions in the two geo alerts, which ship with example.com placeholders.

description.@value: Baseline: 13/90d across 4 users. Goes blind if the GELF collector stops, since plaintext cannot express this query
Baseline: 45/90d

title.@value: O365 - inbox rule created or modified

description.@value: Baseline: 25/90d - classic BEC persistence
Baseline: 51/90d unfiltered, 0 after excluding MSExchangeAdminApiNetCore - exclusion verified to be what silences it
Baseline: 0/90d - privilege escalation. Naming confirmed by 'Add member to group.' (307/90d) using the same pattern

query.@value: Operation:("Add member to role." OR "Add eligible member to role.")

title.@value: O365 - Microsoft alert policy tampered with

description.@value: Baseline: New-ProtectionAlert CONFIRMED by 4 records on 2026-10-13 20:00 when the tenant owner created policies in the portal; the other three names follow the same proven Exchange cmdlet rule. Matters because Microsoft's own policies are now a detection layer: disabling them creates a blind spot, the same move as mailbox audit bypass
Baseline: 0/90d - bulk extraction of a mailbox to file. New-MailboxExportRequest is hybrid-only and cannot occur on a cloud-only tenant; the Compliance pair is the cloud path

Baseline: No plaintext records for 2h (floor was 10/hour over 180 measured hours). ACTION: check the plaintext collector. Catch-up records keep their original CreationTime and will NOT retrigger alerts, so review the gap by hand. Retire this definition when the plaintext feed is retired
Baseline: 36/90d. 'Add service principal.' (60/90d) is deliberately not included: it also fires when a first-party app is first used
Baseline: ~3 human-initiated in 90d. FullAccess and SendAs are how a mailbox is read without touching its password

query.@value: Operation:("Add-MailboxPermission" OR "Add-RecipientPermission") AND NOT UserId:"NT SERVICE\\MSExchangeAdminApiNetCore (Microsoft.Exchange.AdminApi.NetCore)"

title.@value: O365 - repeated bad password for one account

description.@value: Baseline: threshold >10 per 30min; worst legitimate case in 90d was 15, so this fires about once a quarter
Baseline: 18 logins in 90d resolving to 8 distinct trips, about one mail every 11 days

query.@value: Operation:UserLoggedIn AND _exists_:ClientIP_country_code AND NOT UserType:4 AND NOT UserId:/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/ AND NOT ClientIP_country_code:SK AND NOT (UserId:"partner6@example.org" AND ClientIP_country_code:EE) AND NOT (UserId:"based.abroad1@example.com" AND ClientIP_country_code:CZ) AND NOT (UserId:"partner3@example.org" AND ClientIP_country_code:CZ) AND NOT (UserId:"partner2@example.org" AND ClientIP_country_code:CZ) AND NOT (UserId:"vpn.user3@example.com" AND ClientIP_country_code:BE) AND NOT (UserId:"based.abroad2@example.com" AND ClientIP_country_code:BE) AND NOT (UserId:"contractor.abroad@example.com" AND ClientIP_country_code:BE) AND NOT (UserId:"partner4@example.org" AND ClientIP_country_code:(LI OR AT OR CH)) AND NOT (UserId:"partner5@example.org" AND ClientIP_country_code:CZ) AND NOT (UserId:"vpn.user2@example.com" AND ClientIP_country_code:CZ) AND NOT (UserId:"traveller@example.com" AND ClientIP_country_code:CZ) AND NOT (UserId:"vpn.user1@example.com" AND ClientIP_country_code:CZ) AND NOT (UserId:"partner1@example.org" AND ClientIP_country_code:CZ) AND NOT (UserId:"remote.employee@example.com" AND ClientIP_country_code:CZ)

Baseline: 0/90d - mail flow rules can silently copy or divert all mail

title.@value: O365 - bad password attempt from outside EU/EEA

title.@value: O365 - user password reset by admin

description.@value: Baseline: 20/90d by a single admin, clustered in one fortnight - query proven against real admin activity

Baseline: 4 inbox-rule forwards in 90d (all internal), 0 mailbox-level. UNVERIFIED: no forwarding rule exists inside the GELF window yet, so the field names are inferred from the flattening of MoveToFolder/From/Name. Confirm with a throwaway rule

query.@value: (Operation:("New-InboxRule" OR "Set-InboxRule" OR "UpdateInboxRules") AND (_exists_:ForwardTo OR _exists_:RedirectTo OR _exists_:ForwardAsAttachmentTo)) OR (Operation:"Set-Mailbox" AND (_exists_:ForwardingSmtpAddress OR _exists_:ForwardingAddress))

description.@value: Baseline: 0/90d - stops a mailbox being audited at all
Baseline: 26 distinct in 90d (154 raw, inflated by a collector duplication bug), all by one admin. ~0.3/day

query.@value: Operation:"Update application – Certificates and secrets management"

Baseline: 4/90d with this allowlist (LK x2, AE, TR). Strict EU-only would add 60 hits from one user behind an LI exit node. _exists_ guard is required: without it a record missing the geoip field satisfies the NOT and fires

description.@value: Baseline: 0/90d. Names follow the proven Exchange cmdlet rule. Set-RemoteDomain is how tenant-wide auto-forwarding gets re-enabled

query.@value: Operation:("Set-AntiPhishPolicy" OR "Set-MalwareFilterPolicy" OR "Set-HostedContentFilterPolicy" OR "Set-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy" OR "Set-RemoteDomain" OR "Remove-AntiPhishPolicy" OR "Remove-MalwareFilterPolicy")

description.@value: Baseline: 12/90d, all 'Creation of forwarding/redirect rule'. The three excluded policies are user-reported email (90/90d) and carry no attacker signal

query.@value: RecordType:40 AND NOT Name:("Email reported by user as not junk" OR "Email reported by user as malware or phish" OR "Email reported by user as junk")

description.@value: Baseline: No o365-logs records for 2h (floor was 10/hour over 180 measured hours). ACTION: check the GELF collector on dxc-vpn. IMPORTANT - once it resumes, the catch-up records carry their original CreationTime, so they land outside every alert window and will NOT retrigger any alert. Review the outage period by hand. While this feed is down the admin-consent, MFA and Microsoft-security-alert rules are blind, as they only work on GELF
Baseline: 41/90d
Baseline: 0/90d. UNPROVEN NAMES (Entra friendly-string format). Federation takeover is a full-tenant compromise
